data.title: Sick pay (Krankengeld) rejected from 12 January 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK, your health insurer, wrote on 27 January 2026 that your sick pay (Krankengeld) is suspended because your incapacity certificate was reported late. It will only pay from 22 January 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your incapacity for work was not reported within one week, so your sick pay entitlement is suspended (ruht) until the certificate arrived on 22 January 2026. Sick pay will therefore only be paid from that date, not from 12 January 2026. If you disagree, for example because you reported it in time, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the insurer. The app shows the deadline. Keep proof of when you sent the certificate. Consider advice from a social law counsellor or your union.

items.title: Objection to sick pay decision
items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with Muster BKK if you disagree.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.

key_facts.quote: Die Bescheinigung ging am 22.01.2026 bei uns ein.

key_facts.label: Sick pay paid from (Krankengeld ab)

key_facts.label: Legal basis (Rechtsgrundlage)
key_facts.quote: Ihr Anspruch auf Krankengeld ruht, weil die Arbeitsunfähigkeit nicht innerhalb einer Woche gemeldet wurde (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V).
